# Basis — extended summary

Basis provides AI marketing Operators built for Asia. The product workspace lets marketers connect ad accounts, brief specialized Operators in chat, lock brand context once, and ship creatives while optimizing paid media without bouncing between dashboards.

Key capabilities:
- Specialized Operators for ads, email, social, landing pages, SEO, product copy, brand, campaigns, PR, and more
- Brand voice locked across every draft
- Asia-first workflows for APAC channels, languages, and retail calendars
- Paid media workflow: connect accounts → chat → create → publish and optimize
- Token-based pricing with free trial and prepaid packs (coming soon); Team for organizations

Contact: business@basis.hk
Site: https://basis.hk
